headline: Callahan's Passage and Weathered Expanse Erupt with Fierce Frontline Clashes
war_summary: Since the previous dispatch, Callahan's Passage has violently re-erupted into one of the front's hottest sectors, registering over eight thousand combined casualties and two strategic base actions in the past two hours, anchored around The Latch and Crumbling Post. Weathered Expanse endures as the conflict's bloodiest theater, recording four base shifts and upwards of twelve thousand casualties in the latest two-hour interval across Frostmarch and Shattered Advance. Severe engagements persist along the central lines in Stonecradle, where over eighty-five hundred casualties and two base contests were recorded, as well as in Stlican Shelf, which logged two fresh base transfers at Breaker Town and Fort Hoarfrost. Linn of Mercy witnessed renewed struggle at Lathair, while Palantine Berm noted a recent shift at Leiri Hermanni. In contrast, base transitions have paused across Nevish Line and Mooring County despite intense ongoing bloodshed, while sectors like Fisherman's Row, Viper Pit, and Marban Hollow report settled control and diminished tactical momentum.
